index.html.description: Tomato: a 32-bit polymorphic CPU on Artix-7 FPGA and discrete 74xx copper — ISA as wire, dual-LUT ALU (524,288 ALU opcodes), 32,768 GPR, custom ISA, TomatoOS over HDMI, SymbiYosys + Verilator sign-off, hardware opcode compiler, KiCad 07_alu board.

jsonLd.name: The Tomato
jsonLd.description: Homebrew 32-bit CPU: dual-LUT ALU on FPGA and 74xx copper, TomatoOS, formal verification, hardware opcode compiler.

verification.html.description: Tomato ALU verification sign-off: SymbiYosys formal proofs 1b→32b, 476 directed Icarus vectors, UVM Questa scoreboard, Verilator gauntlet 10 billion (8b) + 130 billion (32b) vectors, golden model, make signoff CI.

architecture.html.description: Tomato CPU architecture: dual-LUT bit-slice ALU f(a,b,c)+g(a,b,c)+cin, 32-bit Von Neumann word, modular microcode ROM, 3R1W register file, board catalog lots 01–08, fetch-decode-execute datapath.

software.html.description: Tomato software stack: tomato.v1.csv ISA, Python assembler, pseudo-instructions, two-pass assembly, make burn and regression — the toolchain behind Tomato OS.

os.html.description: Tomato OS: ~2,100 lines of assembly on Nexys A7 — 80×60 HDMI desktop, nine-menu shell, Snake Tetris Fibonacci, tile framebuffer at 0x300000, five-button D-pad, no C runtime.

playground.html.description: Browser Dual-LUT ALU playground: set A, B, C and opcodes, trace one bit through 74ACT151 muxes and ripple carry, opcode compiler sweep clips, interactive 07_alu slice.

isa.html.description: Tomato ISA reference: 512-row microcode, ~37 ISA families mapped, parametric datapath burns, pseudo-instruction CSV, COND and overlay fields in the 32-bit word.

journal.html.description: The Tomato design journal — FPGA bring-up, 07_alu assembly, register upgrade to 32,768 GPR, HDMI TomatoOS, opcode compiler, open-source synthesis, verification ladder.

gallery.html.description: Tomato photo gallery: TomatoOS on HDMI, opcode sweeps, Nexys A7 bench, 07_alu solder and test, KiCad copper, Yosys bitstream terminal, assembly timelapse.

board.html.description: Interactive 3D KiCad GLB of Tomato 07_alu — orbit copper, peel soldermask, tour headers and 74ACT logic on the dual-LUT ALU slice.

viewer.html.description: Immersive full-screen 3D tour of Tomato 07_alu PCB — top, iso, bottom copper, mask peel, keyboard shortcuts.

boards.html.description: Tomato PCB catalog: eight KiCad lots from 01_alu through 08_display — ALU, shift, memory, register file, PC, bus, dual-LUT 07, video.

about.html.description: About Tyrone Marhguy and The Tomato — UPenn Computer Engineering homebrew 32-bit CPU, Ghana to Philadelphia, FPGA + 74xx, open hardware CERN-OHL-P.

source.html.description: Browse the Tomato GitHub repository in-browser — verilog, software, verification, KiCad, issues and README rendered in the paper UI.

journal/ditching-vivado.html.description: Open-source FPGA synthesis on Nexys A7: Yosys, nextpnr-xilinx, Project X-Ray bitstream, openFPGALoader — terminal video of Tomato core compile without Vivado.
